messages:
maria: Quick share — uploaded the micro-sweep csv + charts for L4 vs T4 vs A10G (embeddings + small-chat) https://drive.redwood/bench/1718923456.csv :point_right: key surprise in APAC latency numbers

ajay: taking a look. do we have raw p50/p95/p99 and token/sec by batch size?

maria: yup — top sheet has p50/p95/p99, second tab has throughput for batch sizes [1,4,8,16]. note: small-chat = 256 context, embeddings = 128 input tokens equivalent.

kate: initial read: A10G wins throughput at batch>=8 (embeddings), but p99 in ap-southeast1 spikes for small-chat even at batch=1. possibly kernel fallback?

benchbot: automated summary: A10G median tok/s +35% vs T4 for embeddings at batch 8; L4 median latency ~2x better p50 for small-chat vs T4; APAC p99 on A10G = 780ms (small-chat, bs=1)

ajay: that APAC spike smells like NIC egress/instance packing. which AMIs/driver versions were used in that region?

maria: ap-southeast1 used image: redwood-runtime-v2.3 (cuda 12.1 / driver 535). eu-west1 used v2.4 (minor kernel change).

cheng: can confirm: v2.3 had fallback to cutlass kernels for flash-attn during long sequence paths; v2.4 switches to cutlass-optimized kernels with better memory layout. that might explain regional variance if AMI drifted.

Tim: did we run quantized vs fp16? results mixed, right?

maria: tests include fp16 and int8-gptq for L4/T4/A10G. int8 gives ~1.7x tok/s on T4 but increases small-chat p99 by ~15% (more variance).

kate: for production sizing — if customer wants 99th <= 300ms for small-chat we should recommend: L4 single-node (capped) + bs=1 routing in EU, fallback to A10G for bursts. T4 OK for cost-sensitive embedding-only workloads with batching.

ajay: kernel notes: for embeddings we used cutlass matmul + fused layernorm for A10G, on T4 we forced cuBLAS path for stability. need to capture these in model card so runtime picks correct kernel by region+image.

benchbot: benchmark artifact: gs://redwood-bench/1718923456/artifacts/ (contains raw logs, perf counters, nsys traces).

maria: next steps: 1) replicate APAC A10G with v2.4 AMI, 2) run nsys p99 traces at bs=1 small-chat, 3) add kernel-selection flag to canary for eu/apac. assigning: @ajay to repro, @cheng to drill into kernel traces.

tim: +1 on repro. also let's capture cost calc (token cost/h) for the three GPUs with our current pricing assumptions — I can prod billing for current spot vs reserved delta.

ops-bot: deploy note: canary plan created for kernel-flag rollout (canary id: canary-2024-171892). auto-rollback if p99 increases >10% vs baseline.

maria: thanks all — I'll update the doc with recommended routing policy and a short blurb for solutions to share with sales (L4 for low-latency EU chat, A10G for high-throughput embedding pools, T4 for cheap batched embedding jobs).

cheng: FYI: attaching quick diff of kernel perf (copied into drive) — curious if A10G flash-attn tuning is unstable on older drivers.

kate: OK — once AJAY/CHENG repro we can mark this sweep as actionable. otherwise leave as exploratory. :white_check_mark:
